scenes.title: A belief and a discovery
scenes.viewerPurpose: Separate Newton's convictions from the reliability of discovery; Name inspiration versus public examination as the inquiry; Expose the recruitment of scientists into ideological camps
scenes.composition: Place Newton's private writing beside a mathematical argument, keeping biography and proof distinct. Show readers with different beliefs examining the same claim together. Set competing lists of famous scientists aside to reveal one person's more complicated record.

scenes.title: Lives beyond the camps
scenes.viewerPurpose: Restore complexity to historical lives; Connect biography, evidence and meaning without collapsing them; Bring the issue into classrooms
scenes.composition: Keep the historical record open across several pages rather than assigning its author a simple team color. Lay personal conviction, evidence and interpretation in three separate readable spaces. Bring the shared evidence into a classroom while the historical context remains available.

scenes.title: What can become common ground?
scenes.viewerPurpose: Keep serious belief compatible with shared inquiry; Ask what warrants discovery independently of allegiance
scenes.composition: Let differently situated students inspect the same supporting argument without a conversion gesture. End on the question attached to the discovery rather than on a victory for either camp.
